statements.status_notes: CVE-2018-5709 reports that kadmin/dbutil/dump.c in MIT Kerberos 5 stores a 32-bit value read from a database dump file into the 16-bit n_key_data field: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2018-5709. That code is the dump loader of kdb5_util, which reads a dump file supplied by the KDC administrator. A developer on the MIT Kerberos team closed the Debian report because this code path only runs on trusted input, so the potential integer overflow is a non-issue (https://bugs.debian.org/889684), and Red Hat does not consider it a security flaw (https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2018-5709). Pending: the CVE record is not tagged disputed and NVD rates it High, so publishing this owner as NOT_AFFECTED on upstream's trust-boundary ruling needs a recorded maintainer decision.
